findings.issue: While paused_hidden, the encode rAF keeps calling setStatus({kind:"paused_hidden"}) every frame (returns true to stay alive for resume). Correct for MediaRecorder pause/resume, but causes status-effect rebind churn until visible.

findings.issue: Forward-seek still always clones from floor snapshot rather than stepping in place within SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_TICKS. Correctness OK.

learnings.insight: Closing a scrub critical requires verifying the React binding (local draft state while pointer-down) not only the pure commitScrubRatio math alias — both are present here; the unit covers the seam, QA covers the thumb under per-tick updates.

learnings.action: Prefer this keep-alive rAF + recorder.pause pattern, or explicitly document a stop-rAF/restart-on-visible alternative; avoid pausing only the step loop.
